answer: In this PoA design, each identity posts bonded collateral in an escrow, while evidence of coordinated equivocation links actions into one fault cluster: when k identities equivocate together, aggregate slashing scales as O(k^2), not linearly. Detection additionally imposes an exponential multiplier on capital loss for the controlling stake, with asymmetric depreciation making sybil expansion economically self-defeating. willow, umber, and oasis are labels only, not exemptions.
